mujoco.description: LeashWedge Center Patrol: a low six-wheel wedge pusher with reduced gearing and center-leashed driving for qualification-safe combat

worldbody.description: Contains the complete robot body tree; the simulator supplies the elevated circular arena

body.name: chassis
body.description: Root low chassis frame positioned so the six 0.22 m radius wheels initially touch the arena surface

freejoint.name: root
freejoint.description: Required six degree of freedom free joint allowing the robot to translate and rotate freely in the 3D arena

geom.name: chassis_core
geom.description: Wide lightweight structural deck tying wheels, wedge, rails, and ballast together while keeping root mass low

body.name: low_tungsten_keel
body.description: Dense low child body used as ballast to lower the center of mass without overloading the root body

geom.name: keel_ballast
geom.description: Compact tungsten keel mounted close to the floor to resist pitch and roll flips during acceleration and impacts

body.name: front_wedge_body
body.description: Rigid front wedge body overlapping the chassis and projecting a low attack surface forward

geom.name: front_wedge_plate
geom.description: Shallow sloped carbon-fiber wedge plate with a low front lip for getting under opponents without digging into the floor

body.name: left_antiroll_rail
body.description: Left protective side rail mounted just above the floor to catch rollovers before the chassis flips fully

geom.name: left_side_skid
geom.description: Low-friction plastic skid rail that slides if it contacts the floor during roll, reducing tumble energy

body.name: right_antiroll_rail
body.description: Right protective side rail symmetric with the left rail to improve roll stability in both directions

geom.name: right_side_skid
geom.description: Low-friction plastic skid rail that limits roll angle while avoiding high-friction snagging on the arena

body.name: rear_skid_body
body.description: Rear skid body protecting against backward wheelies and tail strikes during reversing or impacts

geom.name: rear_tail_skid
geom.description: Plastic rear bumper-skid that catches excessive pitch-back motion and slides rather than gripping

body.name: front_left_wheel_body
body.description: Front left powered wheel body placed wide and forward for wedge-side traction and pitch stability

joint.name: axle_fl
joint.description: Y-axis hinge axle for the front left wheel so positive torque drives the robot forward along local positive X

geom.name: front_left_wheel
geom.description: High-grip rubber front left tire with cylinder axis aligned to the Y-axis axle for rolling contact

body.name: middle_left_wheel_body
body.description: Middle left powered wheel body adding central support so the robot remains grounded during impacts

joint.name: axle_ml
joint.description: Y-axis hinge axle for the middle left drive wheel contributing steady traction and yaw control

geom.name: middle_left_wheel
geom.description: High-grip rubber middle left tire supporting the low ballast and maintaining contact over small pitch changes

body.name: rear_left_wheel_body
body.description: Rear left powered wheel body placed far back to lengthen the wheelbase and prevent wheelies

joint.name: axle_rl
joint.description: Y-axis hinge axle for the rear left drive wheel used for propulsion and differential steering

geom.name: rear_left_wheel
geom.description: High-grip rubber rear left tire extending the support polygon for pitch stability

body.name: front_right_wheel_body
body.description: Front right powered wheel body symmetric with front left for balanced six-wheel drive

joint.name: axle_fr
joint.description: Y-axis hinge axle for the front right wheel so positive torque drives the robot forward along local positive X

geom.name: front_right_wheel
geom.description: High-grip rubber front right tire aligned with its axle for stable forward rolling

body.name: middle_right_wheel_body
body.description: Middle right powered wheel body adding central traction and reducing chassis rocking

joint.name: axle_mr
joint.description: Y-axis hinge axle for the middle right drive wheel contributing to smooth six-wheel propulsion

geom.name: middle_right_wheel
geom.description: High-grip rubber middle right tire that keeps the robot supported near its center of mass

body.name: rear_right_wheel_body
body.description: Rear right powered wheel body completing the long, wide, stable drive base

joint.name: axle_rr
joint.description: Y-axis hinge axle for the rear right drive wheel used for forward push and turning

geom.name: rear_right_wheel
geom.description: High-grip rubber rear right tire extending the wheelbase and resisting pitch flips

actuator.description: Six reduced-torque wheel motors for controlled differential-drive motion without violent self-launching

motor.name: motor_fl
motor.description: Front left wheel motor with reduced torque for safer center-leashed engagement

motor.name: motor_ml
motor.description: Middle left wheel motor adding steady left-side traction with lower acceleration

motor.name: motor_rl
motor.description: Rear left wheel motor contributing propulsion while keeping per-wheel torque manageable

motor.name: motor_fr
motor.description: Front right wheel motor paired with left motors for differential steering

motor.name: motor_mr
motor.description: Middle right wheel motor adding steady right-side traction with lower acceleration

motor.name: motor_rr
motor.description: Rear right wheel motor completing the six-wheel-drive system
